fee_notes:
Royalty is the GREATER of (a) (i) 3.5% of Gross Sales (excluding motor fuel) plus (ii) $0.0075 per gallon of Motor Fuel Sales, or (b) $1,500 per 28/35-day Accounting Period per franchised business. Motor fuel sales are excluded from the standard Gross Sales royalty base and are instead subject to a per-gallon fee. Conversion Program participants pay only $0.0075/gallon for the first 25 Accounting Periods, then standard rates apply. Royalty rate on Gross Sales may increase by up to 0.5% if alcoholic beverages are excluded by law, up to 1% for gaming machines, and up to 1% for less-than-24-hour operation or use of pass-through window/bullet-resistant glass.

Additional Business (coffee/pastry) Co-Branded Royalty: 1.0% of that Additional Business's Gross Sales, or optionally $500 per Accounting Period flat fee.

Optional Program Fees: 5%–75% of Optional Program revenue (e.g., Glacier Water, Air/Water, Lux Bitcoin).

Promotional Fees (on Gross Sales up to $125,000 per Accounting Period only): General 0.25%, Local/Regional up to 1.25%, National up to 0.25% — total promotional fee cap up to 1.75% on first $125,000 of Gross Sales per Accounting Period; no Promotional Fees on Gross Sales above $125,000.

POS and Back-Office System Support and Maintenance: $600–$1,000 per Accounting Period (28/35-day). Software License Fee currently $0 per Accounting Period (right to charge upon 60 days' notice). Motor Fuel Pass-Through Fee: $35–$50 per delivery. Debit/Credit Card fees: Visa $0.12/transaction + 1.80% processing; Mastercard/Debit/All Others $0.10/transaction + 3.25% processing. Late fee: $25/day starting on 11th day after due date. Insufficient Funds Fee: currently $50 per payment. Inspection Noncompliance Fee: $1,000 per failed inspection plus reimbursement of costs. Transfer Fee: current Initial Franchise Fee ($25,000 as of disclosure date); reduced $3,000 fee in certain circumstances. Relocation Fee: 50% of then-current Initial Franchise Fee. Renewal Fee: currently $0. Debranding Fee: estimated $10,000 if franchisee fails to debrand. Liquidated damages formulas apply upon early termination.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fees: The greater of (a) (i) 3.5% of Gross Sales and (ii) $0.0075 per gallon of Motor Fuel Sales, or (b) $1,500 per Accounting Period, per Franchised Business, but see Note 2.

Conversion Program participants will pay modified royalty fees for the first 25 Accounting Periods beginning on the Open Date of the Franchised Business, calculated as follows: $0.0075 per gallon of Motor Fuel Sales. Beginning with Accounting Period #26, the Conversion Program participants will pay the standard royalty fees described above.

Royalty for Additional Business product or service offering: Currently, 1.0% of Gross Sales of an Additional Business that is a coffee/pastry offering.

Optional Program Fees: Varies depending on the program but currently ranges from 5% to 75% of Optional Program revenue.

Promotional Fees: General Promotional Fee: 0.25% of Gross Sales (on Gross Sales of up to $125,000) for general promotional costs; Local and Regional Promotional Fee: Up to 1.25% of Gross Sales (on Gross Sales of up to $125,000) for local and regional promotional costs; National Promotional Fee: Up to 0.25% of Gross Sales (on Gross Sales of up to $125,000).

Software License Fee: $0 per Accounting Period (currently). POS and Back-Office System Support and Maintenance Fees: Based on prevailing fee schedule; current fees range from $600 to $1,000 per Accounting Period.
